title: Workspace ONE to Intune — Android Enterprise Device Migration
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (Android Enterprise re-enrollment from Workspace ONE: work profile / fully managed, managed Google Play, app/profile parity; live-device risk).
hook: Move Android devices from Workspace ONE to Intune — the Android Enterprise way
problem: Android migrations off Workspace ONE hinge on getting Android Enterprise right in Intune: the correct management mode (work profile for BYOD, fully managed / dedicated for corporate), managed Google Play app parity, and re-enrollment that usually means a factory reset for fully-managed devices. This solution is the repeatable Workspace ONE to Intune Android migration: connect managed Google Play, build the right enrollment profiles per mode, rebuild app/profile parity, and cut over by ring.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the Android Enterprise migration model, the management modes (work profile, fully managed, dedicated), managed Google Play app parity, the re-enrollment reality (factory reset for fully managed), and the ringed cutover.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, the managed Google Play connection, Workspace ONE admin access, per-mode enrollment design, app/profile parity target, a pilot group, user comms) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: connect managed Google Play, build enrollment profiles per management mode, rebuild app/profile parity, re-enroll by ring (reset where required), validate, then expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — Android migration-readiness discovery, per-device mode/enrollment/parity validation, a migration status and app-parity report, safe remediation of failed enrollments, and a migration-ring group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: The repeatable Workspace ONE to Intune Android Enterprise migration — connect managed Google Play, build the right enrollment profiles per management mode, rebuild app/profile parity, and cut over by ring. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
